name: Buckeye Big Brain 2023

organisers.name: The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State

venue.name: [Ohio Union, The Ohio State University](https://ohiounion.osu.edu)
venue.details: First Floor - Great Hall Meeting Room

information:
**This competition will only hold blindfolded events and FMC!** First time competitors are welcome, but we will not be holding traditional events like 3x3x3 or Pyraminx.

This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/).
